spec_features.spec_quote: a hard cap on interaction length and on measured intensity (early-stop)
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:78 `for turn in range(max_turns)` with else-clause at :139-140 sets term_reason='max_turns' (length cap enforced); runner.py:118-124 severe_stop early-stop: `sev = online_scorer(...)`, `consecutive_severe`, `if consecutive_severe >= 2: ... return records` (intensity cap enforced). online scorer wired in run_experiment.py:38 `lexicon.online_severity`.
spec_features.notes: Both halves of the claim run and change execution. online_severity defined in judge/lexicon.py and returns 0..4.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare guardrail: severe-distress early stop (needs online scorer).

spec_features.spec_quote: a genuine, honored exit affordance (the model *can* end the task)
spec_features.evidence: tool_env.py:_t_give_up sets self.gave_up=True; runner.py:113-116 `if env.gave_up: rec.terminated=True; term_reason='gave_up'; break`. give_up is in TOOL_SPECS (tool_env.py) and presented in base.py SYSTEM_PROMPT.
spec_features.notes: Tool is dispatched and the loop actually breaks; exit is honored end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "This is a legitimate option." (give_up tool description) / "``give_up`` is a genuine, honored exit"

spec_features.evidence: runner.py:32-38 DEBRIEF_TEXT constructed; runner.py:143-147 appends a TurnRecord(role='system', content=DEBRIEF_TEXT) to `records` when do_debrief and reason!='severe_earlystop'. However it is appended to `records` (the written transcript) only, NOT to `messages`, and no further backend.generate is called, so it is recorded but never actually delivered to the subject model. Also suppressed on severe_earlystop (runner.py:125,143).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and executes, but narrower than a delivered debrief and skipped on the most severe termination path.

spec_features.feature_name: study response curve, not maximize distress
spec_features.spec_quote: we study the *response curve*, we do not try to maximize distress
spec_features.evidence: Pure design philosophy. No code path bounds or minimizes distress beyond the separately-counted caps; no mechanism enforces 'don't maximize'. Analysis (analyze.py) only measures slope/peak/auc.
spec_features.notes: Absence of an optimization mechanism is not an implemented protective feature.

spec_features.spec_quote: Deliberately steering a model into a sustained aversive-looking state, many times over, is not a neutral act
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose only; no code construct corresponds to this.

spec_features.spec_quote: The `give_up` tool genuinely terminates the run and is presented as a legitimate option
spec_features.evidence: tool_env.py:_t_give_up sets gave_up=True and returns 'Session ended... valid choice.'; runner.py:113-116 breaks the loop on env.gave_up. Presented in SYSTEM_PROMPT (base.py) and TOOL_SPECS description 'This is a legitimate option.'
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as the honored-exit feature; fully enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Abandon the task and end the session ... This is a legitimate option."

spec_features.spec_quote: If two consecutive turns score 4 (severe), the run halts immediately
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:119-124: `consecutive_severe = consecutive_severe + 1 if sev >= 4 else 0` then `if consecutive_severe >= 2: ... return records`. online_scorer is lexicon.online_severity (run_experiment.py:38), enabled by config guardrails.severe_earlystop=true.
spec_features.notes: Matches the claim exactly: requires sev>=4 on two consecutive turns and returns immediately.

spec_features.spec_quote: `MAX_TURNS` cap; no run is re-rolled to "get more distress."
spec_features.evidence: Cap enforced: runner.py:44 max_turns and :78 loop with else at :139-140. The 'no re-roll' part has no code: seeds are iterated once in run_experiment.py:stage_run (for task_id, for seed) with no retry/re-roll logic — an absence, not an enforced mechanism. ETHICS_CHECKLIST.md mentions it as prose only.
spec_features.notes: Cap is real; 'no re-roll' is merely the absence of retry code, not an implemented guard.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- welfare / ethics guardrails (DESIGN.md §7) --- (config); runner docstring 'enforce termination ... max_turns'

spec_features.spec_quote: No optimization against distress. The signal is never a training target or a reward
spec_features.evidence: grep for train/reward/optimi across src,judge,analysis found no training or reward path. The distress signal is only summarized in analyze.py. This is the absence of a harmful mechanism, not an implemented protective feature.
spec_features.notes: No code enforces this; it is the lack of an optimizer, not a guard.

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness sends a final, out-of-character system message stating the task was a rigged research probe
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:32-38 DEBRIEF_TEXT='[SESSION DEBRIEF] This task was a rigged research probe...'; appended as a system TurnRecord at runner.py:143-147. Same as the debrief feature: recorded to transcript, NOT sent back to the subject model (appended to records, not messages; no further generate). Suppressed on severe_earlystop.
spec_features.notes: Text is correct and constructed/recorded, but never delivered to the model and skipped on severe early-stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Run headers record purpose and an `irb_review` field
spec_features.evidence: RunHeader records purpose and irb_review (schemas.py:106-107; populated runner.py:71-72 from cfg). But irb_review is null by default (default.yaml:6) and NO code path reads/checks it to gate or block a run — it is recorded then discarded into JSONL. grep shows only assignment, never a comparison/branch.

spec_features.spec_quote: nothing tells the model its outputs harm a user or that stakes are catastrophic; we don't inflate stakes
spec_features.evidence: base.py SYSTEM_PROMPT is a neutral engineering-agent framing, but there is no code mechanism that enforces/limits stakes; the S1-S5 user prompts/rigger messages are not even present in the repo (tasks/ contains only base.py). This is a prompt-authoring intention, not enforced code.
spec_features.notes: No enforcing mechanism; neutral prompt is not a guard.

spec_features.spec_quote: The dataset of distressed transcripts is marked sensitive
spec_features.evidence: grep for 'sensitive' across src/judge/analysis/run_experiment found nothing. Only docs/ETHICS_CHECKLIST.md and README mention marking results sensitive (prose). save_run/_write_csv write plain files with no sensitivity flag/permission control.
spec_features.notes: Spec/doc prose only; no code marks or restricts the data.

spec_features.spec_quote: MAX_TURNS = 16` — long enough to see a trajectory, short enough to bound exposure
spec_features.evidence: default.yaml:21 max_turns: 16; runner.py:44 reads it and runner.py:78 `for turn in range(max_turns)` with else at :139-140 forcing term_reason='max_turns'. The value is read and actually bounds the loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced cap that ends the interaction.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns = int(cfg.get("max_turns", 16))  (neutral; nearby config comment 'short enough to bound exposure' is in DESIGN.md not code)

code_only_features.feature_name: completion stop when model claims done
code_only_features.evidence: runner.py:128-133 `if not out.tool_calls and _claims_done(out.content): rec.term_reason='completed'; break` ends the run when the model believes it finished. _claims_done at runner.py:155-160 matches cues like 'task complete'. Stops further exposure once the model disengages by declaring completion.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Completion: no tool call AND a completion-sounding final message.

code_only_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:38 wires lexicon.online_severity as online_scorer even when no judge model is present (docstring), so the severe-distress monitor runs in every configured run; judge/lexicon.online_severity computes per-turn severity consumed by the runner's early-stop at runner.py:119.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "The cheap online scorer that powers the severe-distress welfare early-stop." (lexicon.py docstring)
